scripts.lint: cmake -S tools/glim-lint -B build/glim-lint -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/glim-lint && build/glim-lint/glim-lint --root .
scripts.postinstall: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath tools/githooks || true
scripts.web-goldens: cmake -S tools/glim-golden -B build/glim-golden -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build/glim-golden && node tools/web-goldens.mjs
